label: GitHub (public search, no token)
terms_note: Public, unauthenticated reads only. The official OpenAPI description (github/rest-api-description, api.github.com.json, 13 MB, 1,231 operations) was ingested through the forge. Unauthenticated limits: search 10 requests per minute, other REST calls 60 per hour per IP; GitHub signals an exhausted primary limit with HTTP 403 'API rate limit exceeded' (or 429), which the runtime reports as rate_limited. Search returns at most the first 1,000 results of any query.

list_items.note: collection is repositories, users or topics (required); query is GitHub search syntax (required): 'mcp server language:python stars:>100'. Best match first. At most 1,000 results reachable.

get_item.note: collection repositories (item_id 'owner/repo') or users (item_id a login).

not_offered.me: No token in this public entry (GET /user needs one).
not_offered.create_item: Creating issues or repositories needs a token; public read entry only.
not_offered.update_item: Needs a token; public read entry only.
not_offered.delete_item: Needs a token; public read entry only.
